phase: Block 124 — Review Artifact Generation & Immutability Binding
objective: Create a deterministic, immutable, versioned review artifact representing exact import state requiring human review, cryptographically bound via SHA-256 content hash.

canonicalOwnership.CanonicalReviewArtifactService: Deterministic immutable review artifact generation & SHA-256 cryptographic immutability binding

artifactContract.summary: Deterministic summary metrics (total records, findings, duplicates, conflicts, blocking/non-blocking, review count)
artifactContract.contentHash: Deterministic SHA-256 cryptographic content hash over canonicalized payload

canonicalizationStrategy: Recursive object key sorting and array stabilization to guarantee property-order independence and reproducible content hashing.
immutabilityModel: Objects created via service and returned frozen (Object.freeze), with defensive deep copying of all input data structures.
versioningModel: Sequential versioning (artifactVersion) supporting new artifact generation without mutating historical records.
storageBoundary: In-memory generation and canonical representation without production business data mutation.
block125Boundary: Maintained clean separation: BLOCK 124 creates the immutable artifact; approval tokens, decisions, and reviewer workflows remain strictly in BLOCK 125.
block126Boundary: Maintained clean separation: Production commit and legacy direct-write convergence remain in BLOCK 126.
